secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase Project Settings > Data API: project URL. Supply with VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to use the external project instead of the local sandbox database.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase Project Settings > API Keys: publishable or anon public key from the same project as VITE_SUPABASE_URL. Never use a service-role key in Vite.
